items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I went with Jimmy Rochelle... We played a lot of places... Jimmy Rochelle had a good band. I mean, he kept working all the time... So I stayed with him

ctx.x: What year is this? Where are we? Are we still in '38?

Yeah, or '39. No, wait a minute. We went to Cincinnati to the Cotton Club, right? Then we went back up to Superior, Wisconsin for six months, and then we came back and then I joined Step. So that would make it about '39 or '40, the early part of '40 maybe. Yeah, I think it was the early part of '40, because shortly after that I went with Jimmy Rochelle in Michigan.
So you kept working your way over.
